Employment history

  1. GHL Expert (Migration, Systems Implementation + Team Training) | Life Mediation

    April 2026 – May 2026

    Migrated a family mediation and support business off Kartra entirely, rebuilding their backend in GoHighLevel instead of just copying it across — giving them a system built for how they actually work, not a patched-together port. The result was a full client journey that ran on its own: leads captured, booked, onboarded, and followed up automatically, with reminders and internal notifications handled without manual tracking.

    Beyond the build, I trained their internal team through Loom walkthroughs and simple SOPs until they could run pipelines and automations independently — so the system didn't depend on me to keep working. I stayed on for post-implementation support to refine things as they used it in practice.

  2. GoHighLevel Expert – Multi-Channel Automation & Integration Specialist | Zignify

    February 2026 – May 2026

    Gave a client full visibility and control over their CRM by organizing leads, opportunities, and pipelines in GoHighLevel, then connecting their communication channels — email, SMS, WhatsApp, and voice — into one automated system instead of scattered manual outreach. Integrated Ringover (VoIP) so calls and messaging ran directly through GoHighLevel, and built automated sales funnels and nurture sequences that moved leads through the pipeline without manual follow-up. Set up dashboards so the team could track leads and pipeline performance at a glance, and trained them to run the system confidently on their own.

  3. Sales Operation Manager | Rain Maker

    November 2025 – July 2026

    I fixed a lead follow-up bottleneck for a client by rebuilding their automation — adding proper lead routing and timely reminders — which increased their bookings by 30%. For a 7-figure-a-month coaching business, I built their CRM, pipelines, and appointment setter systems from the ground up, giving their 12-person setter team a structure that could actually keep up with their lead volume. I also consolidated a client's scattered communication — email, SMS, WhatsApp, and voice — into one automated system with VoIP integration, so their team could manage lead campaigns across multiple accounts without switching between tools.

  4. CRM Expert | Course Creator

    November 2023 – December 2023

    Managed the full GoHighLevel CRM for a course creator, building their sales funnel, lead tagging, pipeline routing, and the automations connecting each stage — so students and leads moved through the system automatically instead of being manually tracked and followed up.

  5. Go High Level / Media Buyer For Aesthetic Clinic | Aesthetic Influence

    April 2023 – August 2025

    Helped an agency client manage GoHighLevel across multiple accounts by building their full funnel and automation workflow — from lead capture through booking appointments and follow-up sequences, so no lead was left unmanaged across their client base. The systems performed well enough that I was later trusted to manage their ad campaigns too, handling $10K–$20K/day in ad spend across their accounts.

Magician Corporate Booking Website

My role. Web Designer & Developer — I handled the full build from concept to launch: visual design, front-end development, copywriting support, lead-capture automation, and deployment.

Project description. A corporate booking website for Kent Axell, a Las Vegas psychological illusionist and thought reader. The goal was to position Kent as a premium entertainment choice for corporate events, trade shows, casinos, and private celebrations, and to turn visitors into booking inquiries. I designed a bold, dark theatrical look with gold accents that reflects the feel of his live show. The site includes a high-impact hero section, event-type highlights, a showreel feature, and clear “Check Availability” calls to action throughout. Behind the scenes, the booking form sends leads directly into GoHighLevel through a custom Netlify function. It captures event date, type, and details so every inquiry arrives ready for follow-up. The site was built with Claude Code, deployed on Netlify via GitHub, and includes full privacy policy and terms & conditions pages for a complete, professional launch at kentaxell.com.

Home Hero Maintenance

My role. I developed and maintained the company website, including page builds, layout updates, content changes, and ongoing improvements to keep the site current, fast, and working well on mobile.

Project description. A service-business website for Home Hero Maintenance, a home maintenance and repair company. The goal was to give homeowners a clear, trustworthy place to learn about the services offered and request help quickly. I built a clean, easy-to-navigate layout with service pages, trust elements like reviews and guarantees, and clear calls to action to call or request a quote on every page. Over three years I kept the site updated as the business grew, adding new services, improving mobile usability, and refining pages to generate more inquiries.
